title: Smart Guide

title: What other services do you have other than CLO?
content: **Question** Can I share CLO files with people who don't use CLO? Can I get additional CLO assets such as patterns, avatars, accessories, and fabrics? **Answer** We have other programs that you can utilize with CLO: CLO-SET and CLO-SET Connect. [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/) is an online cloud platform where you can share and communicate with your 3D Garments. [**CLO-SET CONNECT**](https://connect.clo-set.com/)is an online marketplace where anyone who has a CONNECT account can buy and sell digital clothes. Through the CONNECT platform, you can find and download a various type of patterns, avatars (poses and motions), accessories, fabrics, and scenes for free or for charge. If you have any inquiries about CLOSET and CONNECT in terms of account, billing, or any technical issues, please refer to the [CLO-SET Help Center](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us) or [contact us](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). *CLO and CLO-SET are different service platforms and provide separate products, so you will need to purchase each product separately
content_description: Explore how to share CLO files and access a variety of additional CLO assets through CLO-SET and CLO-SET Connect.

title: Adjust Avatar Size
content: **Objective ** Create an avatar with your own measurements. As CLO Avatar Editor is powered by thousands of real body scan data, even measurements not assigned by users automatically adjust to the most realistic body shape. ** ****Location **** **Main Menu ▶Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ▶**Avatar Size** ** ****Operation** 1. Load an [Avatar (.avt)](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002687268). 2. Select the tool/menu indicated.** **→ Measures appear on the Avatar. The editable measures appear in black, whereas the non-editable measures appear in grey. 3. Refer to below graph and adjust the Avatar as needed. **Option** | **Description**** ** ---|--- **Avatar Size ** | Easily select the size of the avatar in the Avatar Size Editor. **Total Body**** **| Shape the overall body type with Avatar's height and chest width. In order to get realistic shapes for body parts without assignable measurements, use the Total Body option to create an overall shape and then insert measurements under the Details option. **Height** | Assign Avatar's height. Because each person has a different head size, it is most accurate to create a full body shape based on HPS Height or Inseam. Total Height is the least accurate and is not recommended. **Total Height** | Insert the height measured from the ground to the head. **HPS Height** | Insert the height measured from the ground to the neck. **Inseam** | Insert the height measured from the ground to the crotch. **Proportion (ver 7.2 [![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/26258263192089)](https://youtu.be/CwB8_ad328M?si=QRMvussOAoDZ_aMm&t=1447))**** ** | Adjust the ratio of the avatar's upper and lower body. **Inseam** | Once the height between the floor and the legs is entered, the upper body automatically adjusts proportionally. **CF Neck to Waist** | Once the height from the Front Neck Point to the waist is entered, the lower body automatically adjusts proportionally. **Width** | Shape the overall body type based on Bust/ Under Bust Circumference, Weight. **Weight (ver 7.1)** | Enter the weight to set its overall body width. After entering the weight, select the desired total body shape and it will be changed to the corresponding body shape. **Details**** **** **| Configure Avatar's detailed measurements. A small error may be generated when entering measurements, and the error appears right next to each measurement. The actual applied measurements are displayed in the [Avatar Measurement](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055394453-Avatar-Measure-ver-6-0-) , so edit them more accurately by referring to them. **Basic** | Adjust the value of the basic body measurements. Body measurements that cannot be adjusted are automatically changed to realistic body shapes based on actual data according to the adjusted measurements. **Advanced** | Adjust the value of detailed body measurements. Advanced has more adjustable body measurments, but this may be more unnatural than the Basic option, as other measurements are not automatically adjusted and are fixed to the entered values. **Simple (ver 7.1)** | When changing the width based on weight, simply adjust the size of the minimized body measurements. **Show All Measurements** | Click the button at the top right of Details to check the all measurements. **Open/ Save** | Open or save the avatar size measurements. **Reset** | Reset the avatar's size to the default state.
content_description: Create a personalized avatar using real body scan data to accurately reflect your unique measurements and body shape.

title: Topstitch Right-Click Pop-Up Menu
content: ### **Objective** Edit topstitch using the right-click pop-up menu. ### **Location** Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Topstitch ▶ Edit Topstitch 2D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_Common_Stitch_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360002922448/Toolbar_Common_Stitch_Edit.png) **Edit Topstitch** ### **Operation** 1. Click the tool/menu indicated. ** ** 2. Right click on the Topstitch to be edited. → The right-click pop-up menu appears. 3. Choose the desired option referring to the following table. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Select All with Same Property** | Select the topstitches having the same properties as the selected topstitch. **Assign to New Topstitch** | Assign the new topstitch to the selected topstitch. **Delete** | Delete the topstitch **Add Internal Line on Topstitch** | Create an Internal Shape right on top of the selected topstitch. **Remove Linked Editing** | Remove the linked editing of the symmetric topstitches. **Order (ver 7.0)** | Change the order of overlapping topstitches.
content_description: This web page provides a concise guide on how to edit topstitches using the right-click pop-up menu in the CLO 3D software.

content: ### Objective Copy and mirror paste buttons (ver2.5.0). **Location** Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button** ▶ Button Right-Click Pop-Up Menu ▶ **Mirror Paste (Ctrl+R)** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005662068/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** ▶ Button Right-Click Pop-Up Menu ▶ **Mirror Paste (Ctrl+R)** **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button** ▶ Button Right-Click Pop-Up Menu ▶ **Mirror Paste (Ctrl+R)** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005662068/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** ▶ Button Right-Click Pop-Up Menu ▶ **Mirror Paste (Ctrl+R)** 2. Right click on the copied button then click **Mirror Paste (Ctrl+R)** from the pop-up menu. → Placement preview displays along the mouse in the 2D window. 4. Click on a desired location to paste the buttons. **※ Note:** * Before pasting buttons in place, right-click to access the Paste window where specific interval and number of buttons can be manually input for multiple copy and paste. * When buttons are mirror-pasted, only locations are mirrored whereas other properties, such as **Angle** , are not.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for using the Mirror Paste feature in version 2.5.0 to efficiently duplicate and position buttons in your 3D design workspace.

title: Add/Edit Bounding Volume
content: **Objective** Add and edit Bounding Volume to add Arrangement Points to new objects. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ▶ Arrangement ▶ Bounding Volume ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005661688/______.PNG) **Add** ** Operation** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location → A new Bounding Volumn named Pan is created at the bottom of the list of arrangement points and its properties appear at the bottom. 2. Set the details of the Bounding Volume. **Menu** | **Description** ---|--- **Board** | Check the list of currently added layouts and edit the properties of the layout by selecting the desired item. **Name ** | Rename the Bounding Volume. **Joint Name 0** | Set the position of the joint(X-ray joint point) where the Bounding Volume starts. **Joint Name 1** | Set the position of the joint(X-ray joint point) where the Bounding Volume ends. **Shape (ver 6.0)** | Depending on the shape of the Avatar, the Bounding Volume is set to the Cylinder and Cuboid. **Height** | Set the height of the Bounding Volume. **Length X** | Adjusts the circumference of the left and right radii of the Bounding Volume. **Length Y** | Adjusts the circumference of the top and bottom radii of the Bounding Volume. **Round Corner (ver 6.0)** | ※ It is active only when the Bounding Volume type is set to Cuboid. Adjust the radius of each corner. **Hands/Feet** | If this option is activated, the length of the Bounding Volume is adjusted to the avatar's hands and feet. The moment you click that option, the entire Bounding Volume is refreshed. ** ※ Note:** If the order below/above the joint points is reversed, the left and right sides are flipped when arranging the Pattern.
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for adding and editing Bounding Volumes to enhance Arrangement Points for new objects in the Avatar Editor.

title: What has changed in the Colorway Editor in CLO 7.3?
content: ### **Question** What has changed in the Colorway Editor in CLO 7.3? ### **Answer** In CLO 7.3, creating colorways has become more diverse and easier compared to previous versions. You can now create colorways with increased variety, similar to actual colorways. The specific changes include: The number of each item can increase as much as the number of colorways, and by default, only the selected items are displayed in the Object Browser. **ℹ️Note** : Check out the entire colorway workflow in the [manual](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000563748-Colorway) or on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WRkb4MR0dP0&t=3837s). **1️⃣ Create more colorways by adding various items with different properties such as texture, buttons, topstitching, etc.** In previous versions, adding items with different properties was not possible, limited to changing textures and colors only. However, starting from CLO 7.3, properties like texture, types, and sizes of buttons can be edited. ![Frame 238.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/25551707984665) ** 2️⃣ Manage identical items across different colorways ** When using certain items with the same properties across multiple colorways, you can now change all properties across those colorways by modifying just one item. **3️⃣****When applying each item (Fabric, Graphics, Buttons, Buttonholes, Topstitching, Puckering, Accessories) to a pattern, you can choose how they will be applied to the colorway.******* Latest Updated on February 22, 2024, ver 7.3.240.46861 See the examples below and make your own selections as needed. You can learn how to apply each item [here](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002273487--Object-Browser-Apply-Button-Style). ![Assign to Pattern.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/30073324508825) **A. Assign to the current colorway only** This option is used when you want to apply different variations to selected colorway only. ![Frame 287.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/30073324557593) **B. Assign to all colorways by linking color chips to change simultaneously** Apply to all colorways, but if the fabric is the same for each colorway, selecting a color chip will automatically select the same fabric across colorways. ![Frame 288.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/30073324589209) **C. Assign to all colorways by unlinking color chips so they change separately** Apply to all colorways, but each colorway is a different fabric. ![Frame 289.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/30073706126361) ### **FAQ ** **Q1.****When I add a different item to existing colorways, I cannot seem to edit them individually. How can I solve this problem?** When adding a different item to existing colorways, they will be added with the same properties. If you wish to change properties in individual colorways, right-click on the color chip, then select 'Unlink All Colorways' to make individual edits. **Q2.****When I save a colorway file from the updated version and open it in a lower version, the colorway information disappears. How can I solve this issue?** The new colorway format is not compatible with lower versions. As the colorway feature will be updated continuously, we recommend using the latest version. **Q3. The****Colorway Editor seems to be slower than in previous versions. Why is that?** Each colorway consists of different items, which requires more time to update. However, we are continuously working on improving the speed issue, and incremental improvements will be made.
content_description: Explore the enhanced Colorway Editor in CLO 7.3, designed to simplify and diversify your colorway creation process with new features for managing textures, properties, and item assignments.

title: Module Structure
content: Module is a system that allows you to adjust the designs easily and combine them part by part. Please see the terminology for the Module below in order to have a better understanding in the Modular Mode. ![Modular_M.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026787527/Modular_M.jpg) **A: Module Structure:** A state when a Block Box that consists of a Garment is sewn to another. When sewing a Block Box that is in this Block Structure to a Pattern, it automatically creates Sewing Lines in between the Patterns as it is already interlocked. **B:** **Pattern:** Patterns to be included in a Block that will be adjusted partially. Patterns in the Modular Mode can be modified and sewn the same as the Simulation Mode. **C:** **Block Box:** A frame that consists of a Module Structure. **D:** **Block:** A state when Patterns are sewn to Block Boxes. Blocks that have the same Block Boxes can be replaced with each other.
content_description: Explore the Module system for easy design adjustments and seamless integration of garment components through our comprehensive terminology guide.

title: V-Ray Render Properties
content: **List of Contents** Render Properties Engine Noise Threshold Max, Render Time (min) **Render Properties YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gJ06vDjNg04 **\- Edit render properties applied to final render output. \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026324647/mceclip0.png) **Render Properties** tool from the Render toolbar and navigate to the Property Editor. ** Engine YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1RTPJI94pHc ** \- Decide the core engine used during render among CPU, GPU (CUDA,) and GPU (OpenCL). * **CPU** \- Use CPU when render. * **GPU(CUDA)** \- Use GPU (CUDA) when render. * **GPU(OpenCL)** \- Use GPU (OpenCL) when render. . \- The option does not appear in Mac. **Noise Threshold YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7rXCIdUsPs ** \- Decide the amount of noise shows in the final render image. \- Default value is 0.01 and it can be adjusted between 0.001 and 0.015. \- Bigger the Noise Threshold is, more noise appears. **Max, Render Time (min) YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=howIckfKQOQ ** \- The rendering process only takes about two minutes on average when default settings are used for Light Properties, Image/Video Properties, and Render Properties. \- However, the render time may differ when properties are modified. To prevent extensive delay, limit the time used for rendering each image by configuring the **Max, Render Time (min)**. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides essential information and guidance on configuring render properties, engine selection, noise threshold, and managing render time to optimize the final output of your rendering projects.
